dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000s8pw](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000s8pw) Magnitude 5.5 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Feb 13 2026 31km W of Jhal Magsi. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 28.3204 longitude 67.1802. It impacted 99364 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
